title: uint32
summary: Convert values to unsigned 32-bit integer class.

gpu_support.notes: GPU inputs gather for saturating conversion and are re-uploaded when possible.

description: `uint32(X)` converts numeric, logical, character, symbolic-constant, and gatherable gpuArray inputs to unsigned 32-bit integer values using saturating rounded conversion.
behaviors: Rounds fractional numeric values to the nearest integer.
Preserves array shape and marks tensor output as `uint32`.
Rejects complex, string, cell, struct, object, and function-handle inputs.

faqs.question: Does `uint32` preserve array shape?
faqs.answer: Yes. Non-scalar array inputs keep their original dimensions and are tagged with the `uint32` numeric class.

gpu_residency: GPU inputs gather for conversion and return a host uint32 result.
gpu_behavior: There is no provider-native uint32 storage hook yet; gpuArray inputs gather to host and return a host uint32 result.
